evidence: app/src/routes/abilities/[name]/+page.server.ts:5 — entire route is a self-contained 2-file directory
app/src/lib/server/pokedex.ts:331-345 — getAbilityPage + ApiAbility type are the only other ability code
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:111-120 — Abilities section/link is the sole inbound reference
app/src/routes/+layout.svelte:14-18 — nav has no Abilities link, so nothing to untangle
removability.rationale: Removing Abilities means deleting a route directory plus one function block and one page section across three files; every edit is grep-findable and leaves no dead code, but it's more than a directory delete.

evidence: app/src/lib/server/pokedex.ts:90 — spriteUrl is the single sprite-URL construction point
app/src/lib/server/pokedex.ts:142,185,376 — but the Card object itself is built in three places, so a Card-shape change needs 3 edits
app/src/lib/server/pokedex.ts:147-195 — all home-page filter/pagination logic in one function
changeability.rationale: Most fixes land in one obvious place (spriteUrl, getPokemonList, format helpers, MoveTable sort), but the three card-construction sites are a genuine fix-it-N-times risk for any change to what a card contains.

evidence: app/src/lib/types.ts:1-17 — components share narrow typed shapes (Card, TypeRef, MoveRow) not internals
app/src/routes/+page.server.ts:1-11 — loads are thin wrappers; grep confirms only *.server.ts imports #lib/server
app/src/lib/components/Section.svelte:3-6 — pages compose via snippets, no prop-drilling
app/src/routes/pokemon/[name]/+page.svelte:24-26 — team state mirrored into local $state via an effect, a subtle coupling between cookie mutation and load data
app/src/lib/components/MoveTable.svelte:99-101 — '+ :global(.move-table)' sibling selector relies on parent DOM order
coupling.rationale: Server/client boundaries and component seams are clean and consistently enforced; deductions for the team-state effect-sync and one DOM-order-dependent :global selector.

evidence: app/src/lib/server/pokedex.ts:133-145 — cardsFor's extra-mapper absorbs real variation (hidden-ability cards) without flags
app/src/lib/components/MoveTable.svelte:9-20 — column config stretches to new columns without flag params
app/src/lib/components/CardList.svelte:5 — showTypes boolean prop duplicated on CardList and PokemonCard is mild flag creep
app/src/routes/team/+page.svelte:37-45 — team page copies the card-list grid instead of CardList growing a per-item snippet
app/src/routes/moves/[name]/+page.svelte:17-45 — facts dl is inline, so an Items page copies rather than reuses it
abstraction_design.rationale: Abstractions mostly stretch instead of being copied or flag-parameterized, but the per-item-list seam is missing (team page rolls its own) and the facts-list pattern would be duplicated for Items.

findings.issue: Card objects are constructed in three places (cardsFor:142, home page:185, team page:376), so changes to card shape or sprite resolution must be made three times.
findings.suggestion: Extract a makeCard(id, name, extra) helper (or make cardsFor the only builder) so all lists share one construction path.

findings.issue: $effect writing state to mirror data.team (also team/+page.svelte:16) is the state-in-effect anti-pattern, and only exists because toggleTeam mutates the cookie without invalidating the load.
findings.suggestion: Call invalidateAll() after saveTeam() and derive team from data, or track membership via $derived; drop the effect.

findings.issue: All six resources' data builders plus API shapes live in one 425-line module; additions (e.g. Items) keep appending to it.
findings.suggestion: Keep the shared api.ts/format helpers but split per-resource builders into lib/server/<resource>.ts once the file grows further.

findings.issue: Team page re-implements the card grid and duplicates CardList's grid CSS because CardList has no per-item slot.
findings.suggestion: Add an optional 'item' snippet prop to CardList so pages can attach buttons under a card.

findings.issue: Each-block key includes the loop index ('${row.name}-${row.level}-${i}'), so keys aren't stable identifiers.
findings.suggestion: Key by a stable per-row id assigned when rows are built in pokedex.ts.

findings.issue: showTypes is threaded through two components as a boolean flag and Card carries optional types/hidden fields, a small flag-creep smell.
findings.suggestion: Acceptable as-is; if a third variant appears, switch to named snippets or variant props.

summary: This is a well-structured SvelteKit 3 app: thin route loads, one API client owning the base URL and cache, centralized format helpers, and narrow typed components make most changes land in one obvious place. The main editability risks are the triplicated card construction, the 425-line pokedex.ts monolith, and the team feature's effect-based state sync. Overall this is code a team can happily extend.
